tropical_outlook: No tropical threat identified for the Week 2 weekend. Search results referencing the NHC outlook indicate the tropical Atlantic and waters near Florida are quiet with no development expected over the next seven days; NOAA's updated seasonal outlook calls for a below-normal 2026 Atlantic season. Nothing found that would affect Tampa, Baltimore, or the Northeast on Sept 19-20. Tampa's 70% rain chance is ordinary late-summer sea-breeze/convective storms, not a tropical system. Caveat: search snippets only, NHC page not fetched directly; re-check the NHC 7-day graphical outlook later in the week.

2026_02_DET_BUF.notes: Buffalo forecast for Thu Sept 17: high 75F mostly cloudy, overnight low 54F partly cloudy. 8:15pm kickoff implies mid-60s falling into the upper 50s by the 4th quarter. No rain signal in the snippet; wind not stated, estimated light (Orchard Park can gust, so re-check day-of). Note this is the first season in the new Highmark Stadium.

2026_02_CAR_ATL.conditions: indoor (roof closed); outside sunny, hot, dry, high ~91F
2026_02_CAR_ATL.notes: Atlanta Sunday: sunny, high near 91F, 0% rain chance, W wind 5-10 kt per NWS via local report. Roof almost always closed for Falcons games; with low-90s heat expect closed. Effective game conditions climate-controlled. Some uncertainty whether the local report refers to the Sept 20 Sunday vs. an earlier Sunday.

2026_02_NO_BAL.conditions: humid, morning showers/fog clearing to partly sunny by kickoff
2026_02_NO_BAL.notes: Local report for Sunday: humid and foggy with showers through ~10am (90% morning PoP, 0.25-0.5 in), fading late morning; partly sunny afternoon with high ~87F, low near 70F. 1pm kickoff should be mostly post-rain but muggy and possibly a damp field. Wind not stated, assumed light. Uncertain whether the report is for Sept 20 specifically; treat as medium confidence.

2026_02_MIN_CHI.conditions: cloudy, cooler, light afternoon showers possible, easterly lake breeze
2026_02_MIN_CHI.notes: Chicago Sunday described as cooler with light showers developing during the afternoon and fading in the evening; overnight low ~63F with overcast skies and a light east wind. Daytime high not given in snippets; upper 60s to ~70F estimated from the 63F low. East wind off the lake at Soldier Field is the main passing-game factor if it strengthens; 10 mph is an estimate. Noon local kickoff overlaps the shower window.

2026_02_CIN_HOU.conditions: indoor (roof closed); outside hot and humid, high ~93F, chance of sea-breeze storms
2026_02_CIN_HOU.notes: Houston Sept 20: high 93F / low 73F. Houston has been under heat advisories with scattered sea-breeze showers; a possible first weak front around Sunday the 20th could bring storm chances. Texans keep the roof closed in heat, so game conditions are climate-controlled regardless.

2026_02_PIT_NE.conditions: partly to mostly cloudy, chance of showers, mild
2026_02_PIT_NE.notes: Boston-area sources disagree: one shows Sept 20 high 72F / low 59F; NWS-style snippet shows partly sunny high ~76F with a 40% chance of showers and mostly cloudy skies. Foxborough-specific day-5 forecast not found. Treat as mild with a moderate shower risk; wind not stated, estimated. Re-check Thursday/Friday.

2026_02_GB_NYJ.notes: Newark forecast: Sept 19 high 79F/low 60F, Sept 20 high 80F/low 61F, described as pleasant. Regional September 2026 outlook for NYC/Jersey City shows highs 67-84F. No rain signal found, but the Baltimore/Boston shower systems suggest a small chance; wind assumed light. No tropical concern.

2026_02_CLE_TB.conditions: hot and humid, showers and thunderstorms likely
2026_02_CLE_TB.notes: NWS-style forecast for Tampa Sunday: showers and thunderstorms likely, 70% PoP, high 88-92F, overnight lows near 80F. Morning brighter with storm threat building in the afternoon, so a 1pm kickoff carries real lightning-delay risk in the 2nd half. Typical Gulf-coast September convection, not a tropical system; heat index likely 100F+. Wind light apart from storm gusts.

2026_02_PHI_TEN.notes: AccuWeather monthly shows Sept 20 high 78F / low 63F for Nashville, slightly below the mid-September norm (~82F/65F). No precipitation detail in snippets; assumed low chance. Wind not stated, assumed light. Noon local kickoff at the mid-70s.

2026_02_JAX_DEN.notes: Sept 20 Denver: partly cloudy, high 78F / low 50F, 24% chance of precipitation (afternoon mountain-shower type). Local outlets describe a hot Sunday before a cooler, stormier week, suggesting warm and mostly dry game conditions. 2:05pm local kickoff near the daily high. Altitude (5,280 ft) is the constant factor. Wind not stated, assumed light.

2026_02_SEA_ARI.conditions: indoor (roof closed); outside sunny and very hot, 101-110F
2026_02_SEA_ARI.notes: Glendale/Phoenix Sept 20: sunny and hot, highs 101F (Glendale) to ~110F (NWS Phoenix point forecast), low 78F, SSW wind 5-10 mph gusting 20. Roof will certainly be closed; climate-controlled game conditions.

2026_02_WAS_DAL.conditions: indoor (roof closed); outside sun and clouds, high ~95F
2026_02_WAS_DAL.notes: DFW Sunday: sun and clouds, high 95F / low 75F, north wind 5-10 mph, no rain mentioned. Cowboys keep the roof closed in heat; climate-controlled game conditions for the 3:25pm local kickoff.

2026_02_MIA_SF.notes: Santa Clara Sept 20: mostly sunny, high 75F / low 57F, 2% chance of precipitation; light and variable wind becoming west 5-10 mph in the afternoon with gusts to ~18 mph. Ideal conditions; 1:25pm local kickoff in the low-to-mid 70s. Sun-side heat on the east stands is the only nuisance.

2026_02_IND_KC.notes: Kansas City Sept 20: 70% chance of precipitation, high 79-80F / low 63-64F, winds 7-22 mph (two sources agree). 7:20pm local kickoff is after the daily high, so expect low-to-mid 70s cooling to upper 60s, with rain and gusty winds a genuine factor for SNF. Most weather-impacted outdoor game of the week alongside Tampa. Timing of the rain relative to kickoff is unresolved at day 5.
